The unmodified standalone browser build is xlsx.full.min.js and is distributed from the official SheetJS CDN release:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

The bundled library is used locally by excel-to-json.html to read user-selected spreadsheet files in the browser. Workbook contents are not sent to the CDN or a conversion server.
